court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Smt. Shalini Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Shalini Singh, Kulveer Singh, Smt. Abha Singh, Raj Pal Singh and Nitin Kumar (husband's family)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. And 2 Others (wife's side)

facts_of_case: Marriage of petitioner no.5 with respondent no.3 was solemnized on 28.1.2013. Out of the said wedlock a male child was born. Impugned FIR has been lodged by respondent no.3 roping in the entire family of her husband containing absolutely false, concocted, vague and sweeping allegations against them.

legal_principles.principle: A person shall not be arrested in a case unless the police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. is submitted before the competent court.
legal_principles.held: After having examined the pleadings made in the writ petition, perusing the impugned First Information Report and considering the averments made in the writ petition, we are of the considered opinion that the petitioners shall not be arrested...

legal_principles.principle: The burden of proving the allegations lies on the person making them.
legal_principles.held: Though the allegations have been levelled against all the petitioners but it appears to be an exaggerated one...

outcome.final_order: Stay of arrest of petitioners and quashing of impugned FIR dated 13.2.2020

use_for_drafting: seeking stay of arrest in matrimonial dispute
